body:
I have this issue. I don't want to set up a reproduction project but it happens to me only and immediately after I select a function in the uh... the filter methods window. I don't know its name. As soon as I do that, the caret starts jumping to that function any time the parser highlights an issue. Video included. The issue goes away if I go to a different script and back.


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eae846dc-bafe-486a-966b-24fb2d20df3b

@Trekintosh Thank you! I tested this and can confirm that this is exactly the trigger on my side as well.

Selecting a function from the Methods list, then editing another function and triggering a parser error causes the caret to jump back to the previously selected function.

I can reproduce it even with a very short script containing only three functions, so script length does not appear to be relevant.

I’ve updated the issue description and reproduction steps accordingly. Thanks for identifying the trigger!

To be clear: this also happens on the same function, as that’s what my
video shows.
